profile.name: Alex Rivera
profile.headline: Frontend Developer
about: I'm a frontend developer based in Buenos Aires, focused on building accessible, fast and maintainable interfaces with React and TypeScript.
I enjoy turning complex requirements into simple, well-tested components, and working closely with designers to keep products consistent across devices.

services.description: Reusable, themeable component libraries driven by design tokens.

services.title: Accessibility

services.title: Performance
services.description: Audits and fixes for load time, rendering and Core Web Vitals.
